input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "insurance", "insur|coverage|policy|policies|underwrit" returned no hits, and a full read of Sections 1-10 (including the General Provisions in Section 10 and the Warranties and Confidentiality sections) confirms there is no insurance covenant anywhere. HDI hosts and operates the Site on its own computer systems and has access to Company Content, user information and data (p0009, p0048), so the absence of any coverage falls into walk-away territory (no insurance for a vendor that processes personal data). We therefore insert a new Section 10.9 at the preferred level in the General Provisions, immediately before the signature block, carrying only the checklist elements (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where HDI processes Company data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request); ancillary "at its own expense" and post-term tail language from the model was omitted as non-element. Fallback of E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M is available if HDI resists.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.9 (Insurance) requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation coverage and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance provision even though HDI hosts the Site and handles Company Content and user data, so we added our standard coverage requirements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where HDI processes Company data, and statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if needed.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance to the Company on request.
